jobs.employer_name: Visa Europe Management Services German Branch Ltd.
jobs.description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world.  Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Manager, Client Success & Eurozone Operations is a hybrid individual contributor role that combines strategic client engagement with support for key Eurozone priorities. Reporting to the Head of Client Services Central Europe and Eurozone Operations, the role supports strategic priorities, transformational initiatives and cross-functional programs, helping to ensure the effective execution of operational and business objectives across the Eurozone and contributing to continued compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.

The position supports the design, coordination, management and delivery of high-profile activities and strategic or transformational initiatives that require collaboration across multiple business functions. A central part of the Eurozone responsibilities is supporting regulatory readiness, coordinating compliance-related activities and helping ensure that relevant requirements, actions and dependencies are understood, tracked and progressed through the appropriate channels. Success in this role requires the ability to build strong partnerships, influence without direct authority and work effectively with stakeholders across Client Services, Product, Technology, Risk, Operations and other European and Global functions.

Alongside these responsibilities, the role serves as a trusted advisor to an assigned portfolio of clients, helping them optimize operational performance, adopt new capabilities and maximize the value of their relationship with Visa.

This role offers broad exposure across European and Global functions, regular interaction with experienced leaders and the opportunity to build capabilities in Client Success, regulatory readiness, strategic execution, transformation and stakeholder management. It is well suited to a high-performing professional who is ready to take ownership within a defined scope and contribute effectively from day one.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Success

- Support and/or oversee the implementation of new Visa products the Client purchases by coordinating key Client and Visa teams to expedite implementation readiness activities and steer the client toward getting faster time to value and maximize adoption of deployed products. 
- Ensure Client operational goals and success metrics for their overall Visa product landscape are understood. 
- Build and sustain a client advocate status with key client stakeholders by proactively executing against forward-looking Client Success Plans, in alignment with the Account Team, to track client specific outcomes including a client’s adoption and performance of Visa products purchased. 
- Participate in the design and delivery of initiatives to improve client adoption of products and use of Visa’s self-tools. 
- Stay current with the latest payment processing trends, Visa solutions and technologies to provide a good Client experience and generate new sales leads as solutions to identified client pain points. 
- Establish working relationships with Client Services and other cross-functional subject matter experts to orchestrate consultation to resolve complex client issues and optimize client performance. 
- Support development of client education and training materials (including webinars) to communicate new Visa Rules, essential mandates, Visa Business Enhancement Releases and/or upcoming changes to ensure client readiness and service compliance.  
- Support and/or lead periodic operational reviews with clients and Visa stakeholders. 
- Act, on an ad-hoc and as needed basis for applicable clients, as the escalation point for managing significant issues and major incident/crisis responses. 
- Proactively identify and drive opportunities to optimize client performance by monitoring client health and liaising with specialist Visa teams as needed. 
- Play the role of the overall Client Services main point of contact for colleagues and clients in your market.
- Deliver Operational Resilience Support - to disseminate approved Corporate Communications’ messages to clients and maintain ongoing interaction with clients to meet their specific needs throughout a crisis event, coordinating and escalating queries where appropriate (as per agreed Crisis Management Plan). 

Eurozone Operations and Strategic Initiatives

- Support the Head of Eurozone in progressing agreed strategic priorities and operational objectives.
- Support the design, coordination, management and delivery of strategic and transformational initiatives, including high-profile activities with visibility across senior leadership.
- Support regulatory readiness and the coordination of activities required to help maintain compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.
- Coordinate cross-functional workstreams, plans, milestones, dependencies, risks and actions to support timely delivery of agreed outcomes.
- Prepare clear analysis, insights, recommendations and management updates to support decision-making and stakeholder discussions.
- Create and tailor a broad range of recurring and ad hoc reports, dashboards, presentations and briefing materials for different stakeholder groups, including senior stakeholders, ensuring information is accurate, relevant and clearly communicated.
- Support Eurozone operational readiness, governance and change activities while maintaining an appropriate level of confidentiality.
- Build strong partnerships and collaborate closely with stakeholders across European and Global functions
- Facilitate alignment between teams, clarify ownership and help resolve delivery challenges through structured coordination and follow-up
- Represent relevant client and Client Success perspectives in cross-functional initiatives and change activities.
- Translate complex regulatory, operational, technical and business topics into clear implications, actions and communications for different audiences.
- Maintain effective action tracking and escalate material risks, issues, compliance matters or dependencies through the appropriate channels.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

- Relevant professional background, combined with a Bachelor’s degree or an advanced degree (e.g., Master’s, MBA, JD, MD, or PhD).
- Background in Client Success, Client Services, payments, operations, product, consulting, program management, risk, compliance or a related field.
- Proven ability to coordinate and deliver cross-functional projects, workstreams or business initiatives in a matrix organization.
- Previous work in a regulated environment, including support for regulatory, compliance, governance or operational readiness activities.
- Strong track record of managing client or stakeholder relationships and translating business needs into clear actions and deliverables.
- Strong partnership-building and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
- Sound analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information and develop practical recommendations.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to engage stakeholders at different levels and present information clearly.
- Strong planning, organization and execution discipline, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies and deadlines.
- Ability to work independently within an agreed scope, exercise sound judgment and seek guidance or escalate when appropriate.
- Ability to navigate ambiguity, adapt to changing priorities and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
- Knowledge of payments, financial services, fintech, technology or consulting environments.
- Exposure to strategic, transformational, change or operational improvement initiatives.
- Proven ability to collaborate with regional and global stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies.
- Understanding of transaction processing, client operations, operational resilience, regulatory compliance or regulated operating environments.
- Familiarity with regulatory governance, compliance monitoring, risk management or control frameworks.
- Knowledge of project management, change management or process improvement approaches.
- Ability to create and tailor management reports, dashboards, presentations and briefing materials for varied audiences, including senior stakeholders.
- Working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with tools such as Power BI or Tableau is beneficial.
- Fluent English and German required.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Visa welcome and encourages application from persons with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

jobs.occupation: Research Scientist and Project Coordinator (m/f/d) in the field of Zooplankton Biodiversity (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at its institute Senckenberg am Meer, German Centre for Marine Biodiversity Research in Hamburg, starting as soon as possible

Research Scientist and Project Coordinator (m/f/d) in the field of Zooplankton Biodiversity

(full time / part-time )

Location: Hamburg

Employment scope: full-time / part-time options available

Type of contract: temporary contract limited until 30.09.2029

Remuneration: collective agreement of the state Hesse, TV-H E13

﻿

The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.

As part of the institute “Senckenberg am Meer” located in Wilhelmshaven, with its two departments Marine Research and German Centre for Marine Biodiversity Research (DZMB), the Hamburg research site, which belongs to the DZMB, focuses on researching taxonomy and systematics of marine life forms.

The position is based within the Zooplankton Working Group and is part of the joint project ZooM-In (Innovative Methods for National Zooplankton Monitoring), contributing to the further development and standardization of modern methods for marine biodiversity monitoring. The project is funded by the Federal Ministry for the Environment, Climate Action, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety (BMUKN) through the National Biodiversity Monitoring Centre’s initiative Sustainable Biodiversity Monitoring.

The project will be carried out in close cooperation with the Helmholtz Institute for Functional Marine Biodiversity (HIFMB) as well as federal and state authorities.

Your tasks

- Project management of the project ZooM-In
- Organisation of and participation in monthly expeditions (March-October, 3-4 days per months) to the North Sea
- Organisation of project workshops
- Assessment of zooplankton biodiversity by imaging technologies
- Cross validation of zooplankton biodiversity assessment by traditional microscopy, molecular genetics and imaging methods
- Communication of project results to stakeholders
- Publication of project results in peer-reviewed journals
- Writing of a project report

Your profile

- Master degree in marine biology or natural sciences
- Expertise in the application of plankton imaging technologies (ZooScan and/or PlanktoScope)
- Relevant knowledge on molecular genetic analyses of organisms, ideally metabarcoding of zooplankton
- Experience in data analyses, preferably using R
- Experience with sea-going expeditions on research vessels and sampling of plankton, resilience to motion sickness
- Willingness to participate in interdisciplinary work
- Very good communication skills, ability to work in a highly collaborative, interdisciplinary and international environment
- Very good command of English (written and spoken)
- Sound command of the German language is essential for this position

We offer

- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations
- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution
- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension plan
- Senckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.

How to apply?

Please upload your application (letter of motivation with a short description of your previous and current research foci, a CV, certificates of academic achievements, list of publications as well as letter(s) of recommendation, if available) (as a single PDF, max. 10 MB) on our career pagehttps://www.senckenberg.de/de/karriere/ by 8 November 2026.

For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/.

For further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung please visit www.senckenberg.de.

Contact

Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung

Senckenberganlage 25

60325 Frankfurt a.M.

If you have any specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Jasmin Renz at jasmin.renz@senckenberg.de.

The Max Planck Society is Germany's premier research organization. The 86 Max Planck Institutes conduct research at highest levels, in the service of the general public, in the natural sciences, life sciences, social sciences, and the humanities.

The Max Planck Institute for the Structure and Dynamics of Matter (MPSD) is located at the Science Campus Hamburg-Bahrenfeld and investigates dynamical phenomena within matter down to the elementary timescales of atomic and electronic motions, the femtosecond or attosecond timescale. The focus is on the use of short wavelength ultrafast probes, such as X-rays or electron pulses, which are capable of measuring atomic and electronic structures in matter of all kinds.

The MPSD currently consists of five scientific departments focusing on solid state physics and theoretical methods in these fields. The MPSD is a partner in the Center for Free-Electron Laser Science (CFEL), collaborating with the Deutsches Elektronen Synchrotron (DESY), European XFEL (EuXFEL) and the University of Hamburg in the development of science based on the X-ray Free Electron Lasers (XFELs).

To strengthen our support for experimental research, the MPSD is seeking a highly motivated

Electronics Engineer (m/f/d)

Your position

As an Electronics Engineer, you will support cutting-edge experimental physics research by developing reliable, high-performance electronic systems in close collaboration with scientists, engineers and technical staff.

- Develop, design and implement analogue and digital electronic systems for experimental physics applications.
- Translate scientific and technical requirements into robust electronic concepts, circuits and complete devices.
- Design, assemble, commission and test printed circuit boards (PCBs) and electronic instruments, from initial concept through prototyping to deployment in the laboratory.
- Diagnose, troubleshoot and optimise existing electronic systems and measurement equipment.
- Develop firmware for microcontrollers and support the integration of hardware, firmware and software components.
- Work closely with researchers and engineers to provide practical, user-oriented technical solutions for a broad range of experimental setups.
- Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including circuit diagrams, PCB layouts, assembly instructions and test procedures.
- As the role involves hands-on development, assembly, testing and support of laboratory equipment, regular on-site presence is an essential part of the position.

Your background and skills

- A university degree (Master’s degree or Diplom) in electrical engineering, electronics or a closely related field.
- Sound practical experience in the development of analogue and digital electronic systems, including circuit design, PCB layout and the assembly, commissioning and testing of electronic devices.
- Proficiency in common ECAD tools for schematic capture and PCB design, ideally including KiCad or Autodesk EAGLE, as well as familiarity with circuit-simulation tools.
- Knowledge of firmware development for microcontrollers, ideally using C/C++. Experience in developing user software for the control, operation and monitoring of electronic devices is also desirable.
- Experience with FPGA development and VHDL is an advantage. Familiarity with CAD systems for mechanical design is also desirable.
- A strong understanding of the requirements and working practices of a diverse scientific and technical environment, combined with intercultural competence and effective communication skills.
- Excellent written and spoken German and English skills.
- Experience in laboratory electronics, measurement technology, scientific instrumentation or experimental physics is desirable.

Our offer

- A varied and responsible position in an international and interdisciplinary scientific environment, with the opportunity to contribute directly to innovative experimental research.
- Close collaboration with scientists, engineers and technical staff on challenging and diverse technical projects.
- A family-friendly working environment with flexible working arrangements, in line with the practical requirements of laboratory-based work.
- Opportunities for professional development and further training.
- Attractive remuneration and social benefits in accordance with the applicable public-sector collective agreement, depending on qualifications and professional experience.
- An initial contract for two years, with the possibility of permanent employment thereafter.
- The opportunity to work in a collaborative, inclusive and forward-looking research environment.
- A subsidy for the Profiticket as a Germany ticket

Your application

The Max Planck Society strives for gender equality and diversity. We welcome applications from all background.

The Max-Planck Society is committed to increasing the number of individuals with disabilities in its workforce and therefore encourages applications from such qualified individuals.

To apply please complete the online application form and attach you English CV and motivation letter as well as all relevant certificates latest 15th November, 2026.

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact contact Dr. Friedjof Tellkamp by email at friedjof.tellkamp@mpsd.mpg.de (https://mailto:friedjof.tellkamp@mpsd.mpg.de) or Dr. Lars Tiemann at lars.tiemann@mpsd.mpg.de (lars.tiemann@mpsd.mpg.de) .

Detailed information about the Max Planck Institute for the Structure and Dynamics of Matter and the online application portal can be found on our website at: https://www.mpsd.mpg.de/karriere/jobs (https://www.mpsd.mpg.de/karriere/jobs)

We look forward to your application.

You will shape the external perception of AutoGyro, strengthen the positioning of our brand and products, and create exceptional experiences for customers, partners and other relevant stakeholders.

Your focus lies on strategic marketing communications, PR, brand development, promotion and events. You combine strategic thinking with a strong sense of aesthetics, premium positioning and commercial awareness.

Join our dynamic team and play an active part in our company’s success. You can look forward to attractive terms and conditions, as well as a free lunch every day.

Tasks

- Drive the implementation of the strategic vision and objectives defined by the Head of Sales & Marketing
- Development and implementation of marketing and communications activities in line with the overall business strategy
- Strengthening and further development of the AutoGyro brand and its positioning in relevant markets
- Development and implementation of PR, media relations and brand storytelling activities
- Planning and execution of promotional campaigns and initiatives to increase brand awareness and market presence
- Conceptualization and execution of premium events, trade shows, customer experiences and other promotional activities
- Development of compelling brand experiences and experiential marketing concepts such as “The Art of Flying”
- Identification and development of relevant partnerships, cooperation opportunities and business development initiatives

- Supporting the Head of Sales at official events, customer meetings, international appointments and other external activities
- Close collaboration with Sales and other internal stakeholders on brand, communication and business development topics
- Monitoring relevant market, luxury, lifestyle and aviation trends and translating insights into marketing and business opportunities
- Supporting the development of communication materials, campaigns and content across relevant channels

Requirements

- Degree in Marketing, Communications, PR, Media, Business or a comparable qualification
- Professional experience in marketing, communications, PR, events or a comparable field
- Strong expertise in Brand Communication, PR, Storytelling and promotional activities
- Experience in event management and the creation of engaging customer experiences
- Strong understanding of brand development and commercial positioning
- Excellent communication and presentation skills in both German and English
- Confident and professional appearance when representing the company externally
- Creative mindset combined with strong organizational and project management skills
- Structured, independent and hands-on working style with a high sense of quality
- Willingness to travel for customer events, trade shows and official appointments
- Experience in luxury, premium brands, aviation, lifestyle or high-end technical products is a strong plus
- Experience in business development, strategic partnerships or merchandising is a plus
- Passion for aviation!

Application Task

To ensure a fair and comparable assessment of all applicants, the following task is part of the application process:

- Social Media Post: Create a fictional social media post for a platform of your choice promoting AutoGyro’s participation as an exhibitor at a major international trade fair. The objective is to attract attention, generate interest and encourage visitors to visit the AutoGyro booth.
- Video Reel: Create a short video reel, e.g. for Instagram, that conveys the beauty and fascination of flying in an emotional way and presents the AutoGyro brand in a visually appealing manner.

Please note: Applications submitted without completing the required task cannot be considered, as the task is an integral part of the selection process and allows us to assess all applicants on a comparable basis.

Benefits

- Dynamic working environment with the global leader in gyroplane manufacturing.
- Comprehensive onboarding and continuous training opportunities.

- Employee discounts via our corporate benefits platform.
- Regular company events that strengthen team spirit.
- Free daily lunch at our headquarter.
- Overtime compensation and additional paid leave for special occasions.
- Unique aviation experience – including a gyrocopter sightseeing flight.

Are you ready for an exciting career in aviation? Then join AutoGyro GmbH.

We are the world market leader in the development, production and sale of gyrocopters and work with partners in more than 40 countries. Our headquarters and production facility are located at Hildesheim Airport. With state-of-the-art technologies, a high degree of vertical integration and a clear vision for sustainable aviation, we are actively shaping the future.

Since our foundation in 1999, we have grown steadily and now employ an international team of nearly 100 qualified specialists and engineers. Through our global sales network, we are consistently pursuing our goal: to bring the thrill of flying, maximum safety and the versatile applications of the Gyro to people all over the world.

As a Supply Officer Aircraft On Ground (d/f/m) in Hamburg, you will coordinate the timely flow of materials required to resolve urgent Aircraft on Ground situations in an assignment with Airbus. jobs.occupation: Senior Pricing & Commercial Excellence Manager & Team Lead (all genders) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule) - Marketing)
jobs.description:
Shape how SUSONITY creates, captures and sustains value worldwide

At SUSONITY, surfaces do more than look good — they deliver performance, differentiation and value. To strengthen our global commercial organization, we are looking for an experienced and influential Senior Pricing & Commercial Excellence Manager to take ownership of our commercial excellence agenda.

This is a high-impact leadership role at the center of our global commercial organization. You will shape the frameworks, processes, systems and capabilities that enable our sales teams to perform at their best — while ensuring that SUSONITY captures the full value of its innovative products and solutions.

You will act as the global catalyst for stronger pricing discipline, better commercial decision-making and consistently excellent execution across regions and markets.
 
Your impact

Lead the global pricing agenda

Pricing will be one of your most important areas of responsibility. You will establish pricing as a strategic capability across SUSONITY by:

- Developing and implementing a global pricing strategy aligned with business objectives, customer value and market dynamics.
- Establishing pricing governance, principles, processes and approval frameworks across regions and businesses.
- Driving value-based pricing, price differentiation and improved price realization.
- Strengthening transparency and consistency in pricing decisions through robust data, analytics and performance management.
- Partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Finance and regional leadership to embed pricing excellence into day-to-day commercial decisions.
- Identifying opportunities to improve margins, commercial effectiveness and sustainable profitable growth.
- Enhancing the use of pricing software and digital tools to enable fact-based, timely and scalable pricing decisions.

Build and lead commercial excellence

Beyond pricing, you will lead the continued development of SUSONITY’s global commercial excellence platform:

- Define and implement a global commercial excellence strategy that improves sales force effectiveness and delivers measurable business impact.
- Optimize commercial infrastructure, including customer segmentation, lead management, opportunity tracking and campaign performance.
- Establish meaningful KPIs, dashboards and performance routines that turn data into actionable commercial insight.
- Drive the effective use and continuous improvement of Salesforce, pricing software and other commercial technologies.
- Develop standardized frameworks, processes and tools that create alignment while allowing for relevant regional flexibility.
- Strengthen launch excellence for new products and campaigns in close collaboration with Marketing, Product Management and regional teams.
- Support post-merger integration by helping build a unified, scalable and high-performing commercial operating model.

Lead people, influence globally and raise ambition

You will lead a team of tool and process experts while orchestrating a broad global network of stakeholders across Commercial, Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Finance and other functions. 

Your role will be to create clarity, build momentum and turn strategic priorities into practical execution. You will challenge established ways of working, build strong partnerships and ensure that commercial excellence becomes a shared capability across the organization.
 
What you bring

- A university degree in Business Administration, Commercial Management, Sales, Finance or a related discipline.
- Significant experience in commercial excellence, pricing, sales operations, commercial strategy or a comparable leadership function, ideally within a B2B or chemical industry environment.
- Demonstrated success in developing and implementing pricing strategies, pricing governance, value-based pricing or commercial performance initiatives.
- Strong understanding of the connection between pricing, customer value, sales effectiveness and profitable growth.
- Experience leading teams, cross-functional programs and global stakeholder networks.
- Strong command of CRM systems, preferably Salesforce, as well as pricing software and commercial analytics tools.
- Excellent analytical and conceptual capabilities, combined with the ability to translate insights into clear decisions and practical action.
- Proven project and change management skills, with the ability to lead complex initiatives in a fast-moving, international environment.
- Exceptional communication, influencing and negotiation skills, including the confidence to engage with senior stakeholders.
- A pragmatic, entrepreneurial and collaborative leadership style.
- Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.
 
Why join SUSONITY?

This is an opportunity to shape a function that is strategically critical to SUSONITY’s future.

You will have the mandate and visibility to build global pricing and commercial excellence capabilities from the ground up, influence how we go to market and help ensure that the value of our innovations is reflected in every commercial decision.

At SUSONITY, you will work in a culture that combines scientific expertise, creative exploration and entrepreneurial drive. We empower our people to take ownership, challenge conventions and create meaningful impact across markets and industries.

If you are ready to make pricing a true source of competitive advantage and to help build the commercial foundation of a fast-evolving global organization, we look forward to hearing from you.
